# Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd.
> Farmer website of Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd., Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. Working with farmers since 2006. Makes biostimulants (main line), biofertilizers and organic fertilizers; sells the Immunity range (Specials for 20 crops, formulas for all crops, 11 biofertilizers, soil granules). Business buyers: https://b2b.gujaratbio.com

- Factory: Plot No. 321, GIDC 2, Ghanghali Road, Shihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat 364240
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99787 91167; email: sales@gujaratbio.com
- Approvals: NOCs from the Directorate of Agriculture, Government of Gujarat for 36 Schedule VI biostimulant grades and 11 biofertilizer types.
- Prices are shared on enquiry.

## Immunity products
- [Immunity Sugarcane Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-sugarcane-special): Made for sugarcane on tired soil: poor germination, gaps and uneven growth.
- [Immunity Potato Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-potato-special): Made for potato growers seeing fewer, smaller tubers and rising fertilizer bills.
- [Immunity Mango Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-mango-special): Made for mango trees: decline, alternate bearing, fruit drop and small fruit.
- [Immunity Apple Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-apple-special): Made for apple orchards: tree losses, low production and poor fruit quality.
- [Immunity Banana Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-banana-special): Made for banana: plant losses, weak growth and low bunch weight.
- [Immunity Citrus Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-citrus-special): Made for lemon, lime, orange and mosambi: dieback, fruit drop and weak trees.
- [Immunity Coconut Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-coconut-special): Made for coconut palms: low nut yield, button shedding and weak palms.
- [Immunity Cotton Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-cotton-special): Made for cotton: weak early growth, square and boll shedding.
- [Immunity Onion Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-onion-special): Made for onion: small bulbs, uneven size and poor storage.
- [Immunity Pomegranate Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-pomegranate-special): Made for pomegranate: flower drop, fruit cracking and weak plants.
- [Immunity Paddy Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-paddy-special): Made for paddy: weak tillering, poor grain filling and yellowing.
- [Immunity Maize Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-maize-special): Made for maize: weak early growth, poor cob filling.
- [Immunity Tea Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-tea-special): Made for tea gardens: slow flush and tired bushes.
- [Immunity Cumin Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-cumin-special): Made for cumin: weak plants, wilt-prone fields and low seed set.
- [Immunity Chilli (Mirchi) Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-chilli-special): Made for chilli: flower drop, leaf curl stress and small fruit.
- [Immunity Mungfali (Groundnut) Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-mungfali-special): Made for groundnut: poor pegging, few pods and empty pods.
- [Immunity Dhanya Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-dhanya-special): Made for cereal crops: wheat, bajra, jowar and similar grains.
- [Immunity Pulses Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-pulses-special): Made for pulses: tur, moong, urad, chana and other legumes.
- [Immunity Vegetable Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-vegetable-special): Made for vegetables: tomato, brinjal, okra, cabbage, gourds and more.
- [Immunity Fruit Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-fruit-special): Made for fruit orchards: guava, chikoo, papaya, grapes and other fruit crops.
- [Immunity Gold](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-gold): Our general formula for all crops: field crops, vegetables, fruit and plantation crops.
- [Immunity Eleven](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-eleven): A formula for all crops. Ask us which crops and stages it suits.
- [Immunity Spices Mix](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-spices-mix): A formula from the Immunity range. Ask us which crops and stages it suits.
- [Immunity Finisher](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-finisher): For the last stage of the crop. Ask us when and how to use it on your crop.
- [Immunity Granules](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-granules): Soil-applied granules that release slowly, for soil structure and soil life.
- [Immunity Azotobacter](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-azotobacter): Free-living bacteria that fix nitrogen from the air for the crop.
- [Immunity Azospirillum](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-azospirillum): Bacteria that fix nitrogen around the roots of grasses and cereals.
- [Immunity Rhizobium](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-rhizobium): Bacteria that form nitrogen-fixing nodules on the roots of legumes.
- [Immunity Acetobacter](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-acetobacter): Bacteria that fix nitrogen inside sugarcane and similar crops.
- [Immunity PSB (Phosphate Solubilising Bacteria)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-psb): Bacteria that free locked phosphorus in the soil for the crop.
- [Immunity KMB (Potash Mobilising Bacteria)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-kmb): Bacteria that make potash in the soil available to the crop.
- [Immunity ZSB (Zinc Solubilising Bacteria)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-zsb): Bacteria that free locked zinc in the soil for the crop.
- [Immunity PSF (Phosphate Solubilising Fungi)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-psf): Fungi that free locked phosphorus in the soil for the crop.
- [Immunity Mycorrhiza](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-mycorrhiza): Root fungi that extend the root system to reach more water and nutrients.
- [Immunity NPK Consortia](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-npk-consortia): A liquid mix of nitrogen-fixing, phosphate-solubilising and potash-mobilising microbes.
- [Immunity Consortia](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-consortia): A carrier-based mix of beneficial soil microbes.

## Crop guides
- [Apple](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/apple): Plant mortality, root rot, low production and poor quality.
- [Banana](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/banana): Wilt, leaf spot, plant losses and low bunch weight.
- [Chilli (Mirchi)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/chilli): Flower drop, leaf curl stress and small fruit.
- [Citrus](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/citrus): Dieback, fruit drop and weak roots.
- [Coconut](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/coconut): Low nut yield, button shedding and weak palms.
- [Cotton](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/cotton): Weak early growth, square and boll shedding, tired soil.
- [Cumin (Jeera)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/cumin): Weak plants, wilt and low seed set.
- [Fruit orchards](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/fruits): Flower drop, small fruit and weak trees.
- [Groundnut (Mungfali)](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/groundnut): Few pods, empty pods and yellowing.
- [Maize](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/maize): Weak early growth and poorly filled cobs.
- [Mango](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/mango): Tree decline, alternate bearing, fruit drop and small fruit.
- [Onion](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/onion): Small or uneven bulbs, weak roots and poor storage.
- [Paddy](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/paddy): Weak tillering, yellowing and poor grain filling.
- [Pomegranate](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/pomegranate): Flower drop, fruit cracking and weak plants.
- [Potato](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/potato): Fewer, smaller tubers and rising fertilizer bills.
- [Pulses](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/pulses): Flower drop, few pods and weak nodulation.
- [Sugarcane](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/sugarcane): Poor germination, gaps, uneven growth and worn-out soil.
- [Tea](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/tea): Slow flush and tired, ageing bushes.
- [Vegetables](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/vegetables): Flower drop, small fruit and short harvest.
- [Wheat and cereals](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/cereals): Weak tillering, yellowing and poor grain filling.
